title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays is a free open play night for American Mahjong at The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre, held with Blooming Bams. You can drop in or stay all evening; all skill levels are welcome, but players need to already know American Mahjong under NMJL rules and bring their own 2026 NMJL card. It runs Monday, November 16, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at 325 Park Central E. in Springfield, MO.
venue: The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre

organizer.name: The Gallery at the Gillioz in collaboration with Blooming Bams
